notes_for_reviewer: Task 1 (feature/task-1-monthly-validation) was NOT on main. Merged it into this branch as a fast-forward before implementing Task 2.

Phase3: monthly penalty is computed inside _robust_combo_return (nested in _per_symbol_greedy). It subtracts (monthly_penalty * PHASE3_MONTHLY_PENALTY_WEIGHT) from the base robust return. When windows == 0, PHASE3_MONTHLY_FALLBACK_PENALTY (5.0) is used.

Phase4: monthly penalty is computed inside the Optuna objective function using self.val_df as the combined dataset (since train_df is not available in the WalkForwardRiskOptimizer constructor). The penalty (monthly_penalty * PHASE4_MONTHLY_SCORE_WEIGHT) is subtracted from the worst_return before scaling by WORST_RETURN_WEIGHT.
combined_df and feature_names are built once in Rule_Set_Selector.run() and passed down to _per_symbol_greedy -> _robust_combo_return to avoid recomputing per candidate.
Unit test: Phase 3 test uses synthetic data and two real rule-sets; Phase 4 test uses manually constructed MonthlyWindowSummary objects to verify penalty differentiation.
All existing imports and config keys are intact. No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb or public function signatures.

Sign convention: higher score = better. The monthly_penalty is non-negative (larger = worse). We subtract (weight * monthly_penalty) from the base score, so a worse monthly profile reduces the composite score.
